name: Statute Hold
description: Hold a foe in place under a statute of stillness so that it cannot move limb or head.

name: Warding Decree
description: Decree a ward over the user and nearby allies that no lesser technique may pass.

name: Rule Pulse
description: Send a pulse of the edict outward that shoves back every foe in a close ring.

name: Lawful Cure
description: Cure an ally of poison and backlash by striking its disorder out of the body.

name: Binding Canon
description: Seal one foe's qi and its technique under a canon that holds until the edict is lifted.

name: Order Lance
description: Drive a lance of ordered force that passes through guards and bodies in a straight line.

name: Pattern Aegis
description: Raise a rampart of pattern that stands against heavy blows from every direction at once.

name: Rectified Host
description: Set the qi of a whole company of allies in order so each technique runs cleaner and stronger.

name: Unbending Verdict
description: Pass an unbending verdict on one powerful foe that strikes it down and holds it still.

name: Ordained Nullity
description: Raise a wall of law that nullifies every technique of a barred kind crossing its line.

name: Edict Torrent
description: Pour the edict out as a torrent that presses down every foe over a wide field.

name: Law Everlasting
description: The school move that sets an enduring law on a wide space where foes are stilled and allies stand guarded.

name: Verdict Cataclysm
description: Call down the edict as a crushing verdict that levels everything in a great field to the ceiling of its tier.

name: Statute Ruin
description: Strike the statute through the whole field at once and shatter every structure and fighter bound by it.

name: Pattern Hold
description: Bind a foe into the user's pattern so its limbs move only as the pattern allows.

name: Stilled Hand
description: Still the foe's casting hand so no technique can leave it for a short time.

name: Plane Pulse
description: Send a level pulse out from the core that stills the footing of every foe near the user.

name: Calm Cure
description: Settle an ally's deviated qi from the core outward and clear a lingering taint.

name: Axiom Lance
description: Thrust a lance built on a first truth of force through any guard not built on the same truth.

name: Closed Domain
description: Close a domain round the user and allies so that no outside force may enter or touch them.

name: Total Seal
description: Seal every channel of one foe's body at once so that no qi can move through it.

name: Restorative Statute
description: Enact a statute of restoration that clears curses and taints from many allies in a single reading.

name: Domain Absolute
description: Make the whole domain absolute so foes fail within it while the user's allies are held safe.

name: Reckoning Sweep
description: Sweep the domain with the reckoning of the canon and strike all foes that owe it a debt.

name: Silenced Art
description: Silence a great technique at its birth and nullify it before any force can leave the caster.

name: Final Pattern
description: The school move that sets the final pattern over a space so that no technique can unmake it.

name: Sentence Eternal
description: Pass a sentence that falls on a single great foe or fortress with the full destructive ceiling of its tier.
